answer_2.quote: We introduce a novel metric, BREU (Belief Revision Evaluation Understudy), to assess LMs' belief revision ability, by averaging BU-Acc and BM-Acc equally.

answer_4.quote: We conducted a human evaluation via Appen 2 , with three native English speakers assessing each sample's quality.
answer_4.guideline: They unanimously confirmed that the conditional relationships in the premises were logically sound across all samples, i.e. that q entails p and q entails r in both of the conditional premises.
